Physical activity level category (PA CAT) definitions

Definitions

Physical activity level category (PA CAT) defined for inactive, low active, active and very active levels

Age group Physical activity level category (PA CAT)
Inactive Low active Active Very active
3 to <9 years 1.00 ≤ PAL < 1.31 1.31 ≤ PAL < 1.44 1.44 ≤ PAL < 1.59 1.59 ≤ PAL < 2.50
9 to <14 years 1.00 ≤ PAL < 1.44 1.44 ≤ PAL < 1.59 1.59 ≤ PAL < 1.77 1.77 ≤ PAL < 2.50
14 to <19 years 1.00 ≤ PAL < 1.56 1.56 ≤ PAL < 1.73 1.73 ≤ PAL < 1.92 1.92 ≤ PAL < 2.50
19 years and older 1.00 ≤ PAL < 1.53 1.53 ≤ PAL < 1.68 1.68 ≤ PAL < 1.85 1.85 ≤ PAL < 2.50

Children 0 to 3 years

EER equations for infants and children 0 to 3 years are the same for all physical activity levels.

Age 0 to <3 months

Males

EER = –716.45 – (1.00 × age [y]) + (17.82 × height [cm]) + (15.06 × weight [kg]) + 200

Females

EER = –69.15 + (80.0 × age [y]) + (2.65 × height [cm]) + (54.15 × weight [kg]) + 180

Age 3 to <6 months

Males

EER = –716.45 – (1.00 × age [y]) + (17.82 × height [cm]) + (15.06 × weight [kg]) + 50

Females

EER = –69.15 + (80.0 × age [y]) + (2.65 × height [cm]) + (54.15 × weight [kg]) + 60

Age 6 to <12 months

Males

EER = –716.45 – (1.00 × age [y]) + (17.82 × height [cm]) + (15.06 × weight [kg]) + 20

Females

EER = –69.15 + (80.0 × age [y]) + (2.65 × height [cm]) + (54.15 × weight [kg]) + 20

Age 1 year to < 3 years

Males

EER = –716.45 – (1.00 × age [y]) + (17.82 × height [cm]) + (15.06 × weight [kg]) + 20

Females

EER = –69.15 + (80.0 × age [y]) + (2.65 × height [cm]) + (54.15 × weight [kg]) + 15

Children and adolescents 3 to 18 years

There is a separate equation for each physical activity level category (PA CAT).

Age 3 years to < 4 years

Males

PA CAT Inactive

EER = –447.51 + (3.68 × age [y]) + (13.01 × height [cm]) + (13.15 × weight [kg]) + 20

PA CAT Low active

EER = 19.12 + (3.68 × age [y]) + (8.62 × height [cm]) + (20.28 × weight [kg]) + 20

PA CAT Active

EER = –388.19 + (3.68 × age [y]) + (12.66 × height [cm]) + (20.46 × weight [kg]) + 20

PA CAT Very active

EER = –671.75 + (3.68 × age [y]) + (15.38 × height [cm]) + (23.25 × weight [kg]) + 20

Females

PA CAT Inactive

EER = 55.59 – (22.25 × age [y]) + (8.43 × height [cm]) + (17.07 × weight [kg]) + 15

PA CAT Low active

EER = –297.54 – (22.25 × age [y]) + (12.77 × height [cm]) + (14.73 × weight [kg]) + 15

PA CAT Active

EER = –189.55 – (22.25 × age [y]) + (11.74 × height [cm]) + (18.34 × weight [kg]) + 15

PA CAT Very active

EER = –709.59 – (22.25 × age) + (18.22 × height [cm]) + (14.25 × weight [kg]) + 15

Pregnancy second and third trimester, any age

For the first trimester of pregnancy, use the appropriate non-pregnant equation.

Underweight pre-pregnancy BMI (< 18.5 kg/m2)

PA CAT Inactive

EER = 1,131.20 – (2.04 × age [y]) + (0.34 × height [cm]) + (12.15 × weight [kg]) + (9.16 × gestation [weeks]) + 300

PA CAT Low active

EER = 693.35 – (2.04 × age [y]) + (5.73 × height [cm]) + (10.20 × weight [kg]) + (9.16 × gestation [weeks]) + 300

PA CAT Active

EER = –223.84 – (2.04 × age [y]) + (13.23 × height [cm]) + (8.15 × weight [kg]) + (9.16 × gestation [weeks]) + 300

PA CAT Very active

EER = –779.72 – (2.04 × age [y]) + (18.45 × height [cm]) + (8.73 × weight [kg]) + (9.16 × gestation [weeks]) + 300
